# New OCF narration proposal; function ID is provisional and not registered.
# Proposed English title: Dissolve
# Proposed English display cue: PLUS-DISSOLVE
# Proposed English spoken cue: Plus Dissolve
# Proposed command identity: OCF-CMD-EXP-003-PRIMARY

# Review note: The function, command, locale cue resources, and narration
# bindings must be registered before symbolic cue resolution is available.
# Review note: Deliberate pattern selection initiates the practice;

# Review note: Existing approved functions and integrity records are unchanged.

schema_version: '1.0'

entries:
  hplus.function.ocf-exp-003.opener:
    status: draft
    version: 1.0.0
    notes: >-
      New OCF-authored narration proposal informed by the user-supplied
      Plus Dis-Create excerpt. Introduces conscious dissolution of selected
      beliefs, emotional responses, and recurring life patterns. No historical
      transcript identity or prior editorial approval is claimed.
      Proposed identity OCF-EXP-003 remains subject to registration and review.
    text: |-
      This OCF exercise will teach you to dissolve unwanted beliefs,
      emotional responses, and recurring life patterns,
      freeing your energy and attention for what you choose to create.

  hplus.function.ocf-exp-003.function-body:
    status: draft
    version: 1.0.0
    notes: >-
      New OCF-authored programming passage, not a transcription or synonym-only
      rewrite of the supplied comparison. Preserves deliberate selection,
      inhale-hold-command-exhale, total-self cooperation, dissolution rather
      than temporary concealment, and energy available for constructive use.
      Adds representation-neutral intention, useful learning retained without
      repeating an old pattern, self-directed choice, and patient integration
      without requiring distress or a fixed completion time. The ability is
      intended to remain available; activation targets a consciously selected
      pattern rather than every passing thought. No clinical or external
      outcome is established by these suggestions. The supplied meditation
      prerequisites and Focus-state sequence are not imported. One passage
      is intended for four scheduled body repetitions; composition remains
      separate. The proposed primary command is Plus Dissolve, supplied through
      cue.primary after registration and review. Manifest remains independent.
      Editorial, rights/provenance, integration, and audio review are pending.
    cue_template:
      function_id: OCF-EXP-003
      allowed: [cue.primary]
    text: |-
      From this moment forward, you are free to dissolve
      patterns that no longer belong in the life you choose to create.

      Bring one unwanted pattern clearly into your awareness:
      a belief, an expectation, an emotional response,
      or a recurring pattern in your life.
      Recognize what you are ready to release,
      without replaying its history or explaining every cause.

      Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.
      Think or say in your mind, "{{ cue.primary }}."
      Then exhale slowly and easily.

      Your conscious mind, subconscious mind, physical being,
      and higher self unite around this intention.
      Every level of your total self participates
      in releasing the pattern you have chosen.

      Picture, feel, or simply know its structure loosening.
      The connections holding it together soften and separate.
      Its emotional charge subsides. Its familiar pull releases.
      The pattern loses its hold and dissolves
      from the way you think, feel, and respond.

      You are not required to fight what you are releasing.
      Meet yourself with understanding and kindness.
      The lessons and useful knowledge of your experience remain,
      while you release the expectation that the past must repeat.

      Energy and attention once tied to sustaining this pattern
      return to your use, available for clarity, creativity,
      love, and purposeful action.
      You remain whole, grounded, and free to choose
      what you wish to create in its place.

      Let this change continue with steadiness and patience,
      whether release is immediate or unfolds in layers.
      Your total self carries the intention forward
      without constant effort or repeated checking.

      Your new freedom becomes a lasting part of your life.
      The ability to dissolve a selected pattern remains
      permanently available whenever you consciously choose it.

      The more you use this function,
      the more naturally you release what no longer serves you
      and make room for what you choose next.

  hplus.function.ocf-exp-003.closer:
    status: draft
    version: 1.0.0
    notes: >-
      New OCF-authored closer with one purpose reminder, deliberate pattern
      selection, the proposed primary cue, and the inhale-hold-command-exhale
      sequence. No repeated reinforcement, second function command, or
      session-state transition is included. Cue resolution requires the
      proposed function and its reviewed locale cue to be registered.
      Editorial approval and finished-session review remain pending.
    cue_template:
      function_id: OCF-EXP-003
      allowed: [cue.primary]
    text: |-
      Remember, to dissolve an unwanted pattern,
      bring what you wish to release clearly into your awareness.

      Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.
      Think or say in your mind, "{{ cue.primary }}."
      Then exhale slowly and easily.

      This concludes your OCF exercise.

# Review note: New OCF adaptation of the maintainer-supplied Clear Zone draft;

# Review note: Permanent automatic baseline with two temporary, mutually
# exclusive overrides. The primary command reinforces or restores the baseline.
# Review note: Observe pauses outward insect-discouragement intention only.
# Review note: Suspend pauses all Clear Zone activity, not ordinary awareness

# Review note: Either override ends at the next normal sleep onset, loss of
# consciousness, or deliberate primary invocation. Automatic mode then resumes.
# Review note: Relaxation and Focus-state labels alone are not reset triggers.
# Review note: Inhale, think or say the selected cue, and exhale naturally;
# no breath hold, eye closure, or new release command is introduced.
# Review note: Intended insect discouragement is experimental; physical
# repellency or protection against bites, stings, or disease is not established.
# Review note: Function registration, locale cue resources, and narration
# bindings are required before repository cue resolution and rendering.
# Review note: Shared Access Channel opening/closing and practice pauses
# remain in session composition; no duplicate first-person rehearsal is embedded.
schema_version: '1.0'

entries:
  hplus.function.ocf-exp-005.opener:
    status: draft
    version: 1.0.0
    notes: >-
      New OCF-authored adaptation of the supplied Clear Zone exercise.
      Introduces an ongoing, consciously chosen intention to discourage
      unwanted insect contact while maintaining calm awareness.
      No independently authenticated source, source checksum, or historical
      lineage is claimed. Proposed identity remains subject to registry
      allocation and explicit editorial review.
    cue_template:
      function_id: OCF-EXP-005
      allowed: [function.title]
    text: |-
      This OCF exercise will teach you to establish {{ function.title }},
      a lasting intention for a calm space around your body,
      encouraging unwanted insects to keep their distance
      and move peacefully elsewhere.

  hplus.function.ocf-exp-005.function-body:
    status: draft
    version: 1.0.0
    notes: >-
      New OCF wording based on the maintainer-supplied Clear Zone draft.
      Preserves permanent automatic operation as the intended baseline,
      whole-self participation, non-destructive insect discouragement,
      primary reinforcement and restoration, and distinct Observe and
      Suspend overrides. Observe pauses the outward-directed intention
      while Clear Zone's calm awareness remains; Suspend pauses the whole
      application without removing learning or ordinary bodily responses.
      Only one mode is selected at a time; a new selection replaces the
      previous mode. Normal sleep onset, loss of consciousness, or deliberate
      primary invocation restores automatic mode. Meditation or hearing a
      command during instruction does not itself select an override.
      Natural exhalation completes the supplied inhale-and-command procedure;
      no breath hold or eye closure is added. Quantum terminology is replaced
      with total-self and intention language rather than a claimed physical
      mechanism. Primary and mode cues require separate stable command records;
      the two mode references use explicit same-owner command IDs.
      One reusable body is intended for four scheduled passes. Shared state
      transitions and practice pauses remain outside this body. Intended
      effects and automatic operation are exercise suggestions, not verified
      insect repellency. Editorial and integration review remain pending.
    cue_template:
      function_id: OCF-EXP-005
      allowed:
      - function.title
      - cue.primary
      - cue.id.OCF-CMD-EXP-005-OBSERVE
      - cue.id.OCF-CMD-EXP-005-SUSPEND
    text: |-
      From this moment forward, {{ function.title }} is permanently
      established within your total self,
      operating automatically whenever needed.

      Become aware of your body and the space around it.
      Picture, feel, or simply know this space as calm and clear.

      When unwanted insects or similar small pests approach
      or make contact, your total self carries one steady intention:
      remain away, move away, and continue peacefully elsewhere.
      This intention extends around your whole body,
      welcoming undisturbed space without harm to other life.

      Your conscious mind, subconscious awareness, physical being,
      and higher self work together around this purpose.
      Your calm attention and natural actions cooperate with it,
      without constant effort or repeated checking.

      Whenever you wish to strengthen this pattern
      or restore its automatic operation, inhale easily.
      Think or say in your mind, "{{ cue.primary }}."
      Then let your breath flow out naturally.
      Your total self renews this intention as one.

      For deliberate observation or interaction with insects,
      use the same breath and think or say in your mind,
      "{{ cue.id.OCF-CMD-EXP-005-OBSERVE }}."
      The outward encouragement pauses,
      while your calm awareness remains active.

      To pause the entire function, use the same breath
      and think or say in your mind,
      "{{ cue.id.OCF-CMD-EXP-005-SUSPEND }}."
      All activity of this function pauses.
      Your ordinary awareness and natural responses remain intact.

      Each chosen mode replaces the previous one.
      Both overrides are temporary.
      When you next enter normal sleep or become unconscious,
      either override ends and automatic operation resumes.
      Deliberately using the primary command restores it sooner.

      Your learned ability remains with you in every mode.
      The more you use this function,
      the more naturally your attention, intention,
      and total self work together.

  hplus.function.ocf-exp-005.closer:
    status: draft
    version: 1.0.0
    notes: >-
      New OCF-authored reminder, not historical transcript wording.
      Includes the primary reinforcement/restoration cue and both distinct
      overrides. The body teaches automatic reset conditions; the closer
      does not repeat reinforcement or install a new control command.
      All three commands use an easy inhale and natural exhale, without a
      breath hold. Requires registered function and reviewed locale cues.
      Editorial approval and finished-session review remain pending.
    cue_template:
      function_id: OCF-EXP-005
      allowed:
      - function.title
      - cue.primary
      - cue.id.OCF-CMD-EXP-005-OBSERVE
      - cue.id.OCF-CMD-EXP-005-SUSPEND
    text: |-
      Remember, to strengthen or restore {{ function.title }},
      inhale easily, think or say in your mind, "{{ cue.primary }},"
      and exhale naturally.

      With the same breath, use "{{ cue.id.OCF-CMD-EXP-005-OBSERVE }}"
      to allow intentional contact,
      or "{{ cue.id.OCF-CMD-EXP-005-SUSPEND }}" to pause the entire function.

      This concludes your OCF exercise.

locales/en-US/hplus-OCF-EXP-001.yaml::hp.after:
From this moment forward, you will direct your total self
toward the reality you choose to create,
with clear, positive intention.

Whenever you desire a change, choose the outcome
and when you wish it to take form.
Whether the need is immediate or further ahead,
picture, feel, or simply know the result as fulfilled.

Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.
Think or say in your mind, "Plus Manifest."
Then exhale slowly through your mouth.

Your total self will immediately align with your intention.
Your conscious mind, subconscious mind, higher self,
and physical being will work together in harmony.

Struggle, fear, harsh judgment, and impatience will fall away.
Your intention remains clear as you release the need
to force each step or continually check the result.

Center yourself in your heart.
Let love fill your being and bring your energy centers
into open, balanced harmony.
Remain grounded and present, receptive to energy and light.
You are worthy to create and receive good.

Welcome the loving guidance of your higher self
and the helpers you recognize.
Your intuition will become clearer,
guiding you to recognize opportunities and act.

Your greater awareness will reach beyond your physical body,
connecting with universal consciousness.
Your intention will draw together and sustain
the conditions and connections that support your chosen reality.

Hold the essence of your desire while welcoming
its fulfillment or something better,
in harmony with your highest good and the good of others,
without destructive effects upon anyone.

This pattern will continue without constant conscious effort,
unfolding immediately or through its natural sequence.
Once learned, this ability remains permanently available,
ready for everyday use with your intention, breath, and command.

The more you use this function,
the clearer your intention, the stronger your alignment,
and the easier and more effective manifestation becomes.
locales/en-US/hplus-OCF-EXP-001.yaml::hp.before:
From this moment forward, you have the ability
to set in motion a new pattern for your future.

Whenever you desire a different state of being,
choose clearly what you wish to create.
See yourself already living that reality.
Feel its meaning, its harmony,
and the change it brings into your life.

Know the condition you desire,
and choose when you wish it to be complete.
Hold that intention clearly within your awareness.

Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

Think or say in your mind, "Plus Manifest."

Then exhale slowly through your mouth.

Your total self will immediately begin
aligning with the pattern you have chosen.
Your thoughts, feelings, actions, and physical being
will move into harmony with your intention.

Your greater self will extend its awareness
beyond the limits of your physical body,
reaching into the wider field of consciousness
and the possibilities available to you.

Your intention will become a clear pattern,
drawing together the conditions, connections,
opportunities, and changes that support
the reality you wish to experience.

Some changes will begin at once.
Others will unfold in their proper sequence,
moving toward the completion you have envisioned.

Your total self will continue this process
without the need for constant conscious effort.
You will recognize opportunities and act upon them
naturally, confidently, and at the appropriate time.

This pattern will operate in harmony
with your greater well-being,
without destructive effects upon others.

From this moment forward, the ability
to create and direct future patterns
is permanently available to you.

Each time you use Plus Manifest,
your intention becomes clearer,
your alignment stronger,
and this process easier and more effective.
